conventions.axis: Blender is Z-up right-handed; UE is Z-up left-handed. USD import into UE 5.4+ handles the conversion natively; FBX bundle exports with -Z forward / Y up + baked space transform; glTF with +Y up.
conventions.units: Blender native metres. UE works in centimetres — USD carries metres-per-unit metadata and UE converts on import; the FBX export applies unit scale.
conventions.materials: Principled BSDF names map to M_<name> on import (USD/gltf carry materials; FBX carries lambert-ish approximations).
conventions.animation: Armature bone animation exports through all three formats (FBX bake_anim, glTF export_animations, USD native); UE imports as AnimSequences on the SK_ skeleton.

unreal_import.note: import verified only after real UE 5.4+ editor execution — see UNREAL_MCP_REQUIREMENTS.md §5
